helpMenuWhatIsThisA: Quiz Tracker helps you easily track scores in any quiz. It doesn’t include built-in questions or a preset game — you set the rules, create the rounds, and decide how the game works. Perfect for custom quizzes and homemade game nights.
helpMenuWhatDoYouMeanQ: 💡What do you mean there is no game, how do I use it then?
helpMenuWhatDoYouMeanA: You can use Quiz Tracker in any way you like — for example, ask an AI chatbot to generate questions and host your own gameshow with friends, play YouTube quizzes like “Guess the Song” and track scores here, or create your own set of personal questions that only your group will know. The possibilities are endless — get creative!
